tex_content.html:
Theorem
Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0053 1. Theorem 2.16\group neckpinch

Let $\bar s(t)$ be the location of the smallest neck. Then near a neckpinch there are inner- and intermediate-layer estimates comparing $\psi (x,t)$ to $\sqrt{2(n-1)(T-t)}$, with quadratic control in the inner layer and a logarithmic control in the intermediate layer.
